title: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmen
question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.cust_id,
         SUM((c.unit_price - c.unit_cost) * s.quantity_sold) AS profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
  JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  JOIN costs c ON c.prod_id = s.prod_id AND c.time_id = s.time_id AND c.channel_id = s.channel_id AND c.promo_id = s.promo_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
    AND t.calendar_year = 2021
  GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT cust_id, profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY profit) AS tier
  FROM base
)
SELECT tier, MAX(profit) AS highest_profit, MIN(profit) AS lowest_profit
FROM ranked
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

         SUM((c.unit_price - c.unit_cost) * s.quantity_sold) AS profit

ranked AS (

  FROM it
